//: Race-tile cameras (P1-R05), format jj.framing.v1. The chase presets, first person and its mirror are seeded from the design POC's framing (art/ui/poc/shared/framing.json, P1-U05.2, R98) and are TUNE values until the owner accepts the POC at G-DESIGN. Distances in metres from the car's origin (on the ground between the axles). `rig` holds the host's own tuning: the spring that follows the chase point, speed-scaled look-ahead, the pull-in when a barrier or building hides the car, the first-person comfort limits and speed FOV kick. `byCount` is the host's default distance by the number of players on screen (mid at every count, as the POC frames it, until playtests pick per count); each player may override it for their tile. The first-person eye sits further forward than the POC's (1.05 m, not 0.45 m) because the baked Cruz Missile's bonnet is higher than the POC car's: at 0.45 m it filled 40 % of the tile. `reverse` is the reversing camera (br-dim.4): once the car has moved backwards faster than `enterMps` for `enterHoldS` the chase swings round over `blendS` to look the way it travels, and swings back once it has gone forward faster than `exitMps` for `exitHoldS` (the holds and thresholds are the hysteresis, so a brief reverse tap never flips it; first person never swings, its mirror is the toggle for looking back). `loop` is the loop shot (br-xlvx.6): once the car is `enterUpM` above the road inside a loop's footprint (widened by `marginM`) the chase cuts to a shot from the exit's side, `azimuthDeg` round from side-on towards the way out and `upOfTop` of the way up to the top (side-on, the barriers at the top hide the car), framing the whole loop with `marginM` to spare, aiming `panToCar` of the way from the loop's middle to the car, and cuts back behind the car at the exit. Nothing here caps anything.
